body: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands are a British Overseas Territory, counted as the UK for country streaks. Coverage is limited to a few Generation 3 trekkers in Grytviken and isolated fjords, so memorizing the trekkers is key.
Abandoned, rusted machinery can be seen in Grytviken. Grytviken is the only pinpointable trekker in South Georgia, appearing in maps like 'A Community World'.
A church and another building made of white painted wood can also be seen in Grytviken.
This wide open valley with lightly snow-capped mountains can be seen on the west side of South Georgia Island.
Prion Island can be recognized by the wooden walkway, lush green plants, and numerous seals.
This boat trekker in Hercules Bay can be recognized by a man in a red jacket and the MS National Geographic Explorer in the background.
